title: Revelation Space
author: Alastair Reynolds
summary: An archaeologist investigating a vanished alien civilisation, a ship's crew carrying a dying captain and an assassin on a mission slowly converge. Reynolds sets them across a bleak future of slow interstellar travel.
readIf: you like gloomy, far-future science fiction with large ideas and an eerie atmosphere.
skipIf: you want upbeat characters or a light, simple story.
